content.text: Many [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-working-2|Get Digital]] creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya struggle to sell [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-works-how-deploy-8|ebooks]] and digital products online due to platform restrictions, such as Stripe's absence from their market. This leaves them with no choice but to use expensive, fee-heavy platforms like Gumroad, which charge 10% on every sale, netting them $921 less per month at 100 sales compared to using NOWPayments at a 0.5% fee. It's time to break free from these constraints and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, like the one offered by COREMERCH, which empowers creators to own their [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-2|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] and avoid platform fees. This guide will walk you through the process of accepting Bitcoin for ebook sales without relying on Stripe or any other platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-guide-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

The core advantage of a sovereign digital commerce stack is that it allows creators to bypass platform fees and restrictions. By designating a specific blockchain for payment processing and automating the delivery of digital products, creators can avoid expensive intermediaries like Gumroad and focus on selling their content directly to customers. This not only saves them money but also gives them greater control over their online presence and customer relationships.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to have a basic understanding of blockchain technology and the specific tools and services required for payment processing and digital product delivery. This includes setting up a NOWPayments account, configuring Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automated delivery, and linking your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages-hosted website to your payment processor. A solid foundation in coding concepts and basic infrastructure setup will also be beneficial for successful deployment and ongoing maintenance.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure NOWPayments as your payment processor, linking it to your chosen blockchain for payment processing. Next, you'll need to automate the delivery of digital products using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, integrating it with your payment processor to ensure seamless transactions. This will require setting up API keys, configuring webhooks, and testing your pipeline to ensure smooth operation.
A sovereign digital commerce stack empowers creators to bypass platform fees and restrictions, giving them greater control over their online presence and customer relationships.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, you can go live and start processing transactions. This involves setting up your website, linking it to your payment processor, and conducting thorough testing to ensure that all components are working as expected. With your sovereign digital commerce stack in place, you can now focus on selling your ebooks and digital products, knowing that you have a reliable and cost-effective infrastructure to support your business.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your business grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to accommodate increased traffic and transactions. This involves monitoring your system's performance, optimizing components as needed, and expanding your payment processor and delivery pipeline to handle greater demand. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll have the flexibility to scale at your own pace, without being beholden to platform restrictions or fees.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
A cost-effective infrastructure like the one offered by COREMERCH can save creators $921 per month at 100 sales compared to using Gumroad.

If you're interested in building a sovereign digital commerce stack like the one described in this guide, we recommend checking out our Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to deploy a cost-effective and reliable digital commerce infrastructure. With this kit, you can instantaneously download and begin building your own infrastructure without worrying about platform restrictions or fees. Visit our products page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

To successfully deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these concrete steps: Set up a NOWPayments account and configure it as your payment processor; Automate digital product delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script; Integrate your payment processor with your delivery pipeline; Test your pipeline thoroughly to ensure seamless transactions; Monitor system performance and optimize components as needed; Expand payment processor and delivery pipeline to accommodate increased demand; Regularly review and update your infrastructure to ensure optimal performance.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I ensure that my payment processor and delivery pipeline are securely integrated?

To ensure secure integration, make sure to use HTTPS for your website and payment processor, and implement robust authentication and authorization protocols to prevent unauthorized access. Additionally, configure webhooks and API keys properly to prevent data breaches or misconfigured integrations.
Can I use multiple payment processors with my sovereign digital commerce stack?

Yes, you can use multiple payment processors with your sovereign digital commerce stack, but this will require additional configuration and testing to ensure seamless operation. Be sure to research and compare different payment processors before making a decision.
How do I handle customer support and refunds with a sovereign digital commerce stack?

To handle customer support and refunds, you'll need to implement a robust customer support system, such as a ticketing system or live chat, and establish clear refund policies and procedures. This will require setting up communication channels and integrating them with your payment processor and delivery pipeline.
Can I sell digital products on multiple platforms with a sovereign digital commerce stack?

Yes, you can sell digital products on multiple platforms with a sovereign digital commerce stack, but this will require additional configuration and testing to ensure seamless operation. Be sure to research and compare different platforms before making a decision.
How do I ensure that my digital products are delivered securely and efficiently?

To ensure secure and efficient delivery, use a reliable delivery service, such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and integrate it with your payment processor to automate the delivery process. Additionally, configure webhooks and API keys properly to prevent data breaches or misconfigured integrations.
A reliable and scalable digital commerce stack is essential for growing businesses, allowing them to adapt to increased demand and optimize their infrastructure for optimal performance.
